description: This file defines Sass mixins for setting border-radius properties with support for various directional and corner-specific radii, including validation for negative values.

methods.name: valid-radius
methods.description: Helper function to replace negative radius values with 0 to ensure valid border-radius values.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Main mixin to apply border-radius with optional fallback, applying rounded corners if enabled.

methods.name: border-top-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying top-left and top-right border radii.

methods.name: border-end-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying top-right and bottom-right border radii.

methods.name: border-bottom-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying bottom-right and bottom-left border radii.

methods.name: border-start-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying top-left and bottom-left border radii.

methods.name: border-top-start-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying top-left border radius.

methods.name: border-top-end-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying top-right border radius.

methods.name: border-bottom-end-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying bottom-right border radius.

methods.name: border-bottom-start-radius
methods.description: Mixin for applying bottom-left border radius.
